name: kbravh-skills
description: A collection of AI skills and plugins for Claude Code and other Claude agents.

plugins.name: proton-pass-secrets
plugins.description: Read secrets from Proton Pass with pass-cli secret references (pass://vault/item/field) — inject API tokens and passwords into commands, env files, and config templates without exposing plaintext.

plugins.name: html-specs
plugins.description: Create engaging, self-contained HTML slide decks for specs, implementation plans, ADRs, and brainstorm docs — keyboard-navigable single-file decks with a dark slate + emerald design system and ready-made components.

plugins.name: game-design-brainstorming
plugins.description: A creative collaborator for video game design — turn loose ideas, themes, and mechanics into specific gameplay loops, design pillars, and pitch documents. Direct, opinionated, reference-heavy.

plugins.name: logo-design
plugins.description: Brand discovery and SVG logo creation: develop logo concepts from brand research and competitor analysis, then turn the approved concept brief into production SVG logos and variations.

plugins.name: prisma-expand-contract
plugins.description: Safe database schema migrations using the expand-and-contract pattern with Prisma ORM. Rename columns and tables, change types, and add non-nullable columns with zero downtime.

plugins.name: tanstack-query
plugins.description: TanStack Query (React Query) v5 best practices for data fetching, caching, and mutations: query keys, invalidation, optimistic updates, SSR, and testing.
